syntactic_observation.scope: Structural observation only; does not prove pointer safety, retag/borrow semantics, call normality or source-current/future correspondence.

pointer_add.note: Offset bytes must fit isize; the mathematical result address must fit usize; a nonzero movement stays within the originating allocation. These safety conditions precede any dereference.

allocation.note: Allocation base is nonzero, base+size fits usize, size fits isize. A valid array subregion need not start at the allocation base; coallocated disjoint fields remain allowed.

reference_validity.note: References require alignment, non-nullness, a live allocation covering the pointee span and valid referent values. Full alias/liveness semantics are not completely specified; this is not a proof that a source-to-heap embedding is adequate.
